process HACKGAP_COUNT {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/hackgap:1.0.1--pyhdfd78af_0'
        : 'quay.io/biocontainers/hackgap:1.0.1--pyhdfd78af_0'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reads)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.hash"), emit: hash
    tuple val(meta), path("*.info"), emit: info
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('hackgap'), eval("hackgap --version"), topic: versions, emit: versions_hackgap

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def cpus = task.cpus as int

    def subtables = Math.max([(cpus / 2) as int - 1, cpus - 3, 19].min(), 1)
    if ((subtables % 2) == 0) {
        subtables += 1
    }

    def read_threads = Math.ceil(subtables / 10) as int

    def split_threads = 2 * read_threads

    if ((subtables + read_threads + split_threads) >= cpus) {
        read_threads = 1
        split_threads = 2
    }
    """
    hackgap count \\
        ${args} \\
        --threads-split ${split_threads} \\
        --threads-read ${read_threads} \\
        --subtables ${subtables} \\
        --files ${reads} \\
        --out ${prefix}
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.hash
    touch ${prefix}.info
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/hackgap/count"
description: "Fast, JIT-compiled k-mer counter supporting both contiguous and gapped\
  \ k-mers using multi-way bucketed Cuckoo hash tables."
keywords:
- "k-mer"
- "counting"
- "gapped k-mer"
- "genomics"
- "hashing"
tools:
- hackgap:
    description: "hackgap (hash-based counting of k-mers with gaps) provides a fast\
      \ jit-compiled k-kmer counter which supports gapped k-mers."
    homepage: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/hackgap"
    documentation: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/hackgap"
    tool_dev_url: "https://gitlab.com/rahmannlab/hackgap"
    doi: "10.4230/LIPICS.WABI.2022.12"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reads:
      type: "file"
      description: "Input genomic sequence files (FASTA/FASTQ), can be compressed\
        \ (gzip, xz, bzip2)."
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fastq,fq,gz,xz,bz2}"
output:
  hash:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.hash':
        type: "file"
        description: "Binary hash-table dump containing calculated k-mer integer encodings."
        pattern: "*.hash"
  info:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.info':
        type: "file"
        description: "Contains metadata information on multi-way bucketed k-mer cuckoo\
          \ hashing"
        pattern: "*.info"
  versions_hackgap:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - hackgap:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - hackgap --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - hackgap:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - hackgap --version:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@LeonHornich"
maintainers:
- "@LeonHornich"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
